definitions.explanation: On some occasions; now and then.

examples.japanese: {時々|ときどき}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ます→見る：00283_miru⟧。
{時々|ときどき}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{時々|ときどき}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}ります→降る：00839_furu⟧。
{時々|ときどき}⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes go out to eat with friends.

examples.japanese: {時々|ときどき}⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}します→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかったです→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes remember the old days. My childhood was fun.

notes:
{時々|ときどき} means "sometimes" or "from time to time," indicating irregular or occasional occurrence.

FREQUENCY SPECTRUM:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (100%)
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: often (70-80%)
- {時々|ときどき}: sometimes (30-50%)
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧: occasionally (10-20%)
- ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧...⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: rarely (5-10%)
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧...⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: never (0%)

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically placed before the verb or at the beginning of a sentence.

USAGE NOTES:
{時々|ときどき} suggests more regularity than ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧. Use {時々|ときどき} for things that happen with some predictability, and ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧ for truly rare occurrences.
